data.body: PREPLANNING_CONTEXT_LIGHTWEIGHT: {"version":1,"schema_version":2,"epicId":"waxen-sigma","generatedAt":"2026-06-02T02:06:12.175944+00:00","generatedBy":"preplanning-lightweight","epic":{"title":"fix-bug recurrence prevention: tree-wide antipattern scan and hermetic repro","description":"Additive fix-bug discipline gates: (1) tree-wide antipattern scan after every fix with an Antipattern-Scan commit trailer + commit-gate; (2) hermetic-repro requirement for shell/bash RED tests via run-hermetic.sh.","successCriteria":["sc-1: fix-bug shell-script fix emits Antipattern-Scan trailer (query + scan-root + match count) from anti-pattern-scan.md SCAN_RESULT.","sc-2: check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh refuses commit on missing trailer or matches>0 without per-match follow-up artifact; covers Phase G fix commits; never gates other skills.","sc-3: shell/bash RED test failing to reproduce under run-hermetic.sh triggers HARD-GATE full stop; non-shell runners emit HERMETIC_SKIP and are never blocked.","sc-4: Phase G promote-query sub-step appends to known-antipatterns.yaml when present, else writes durable ANTIPATTERN_PROMOTE_DEFERRED comment.","sc-5: deterministic tests/ regression fixture runs first fix's query against the four Pattern 3 chain files asserting >=4 matches, no original environment required."]},"researchFindings":[],"stories":[],"doneDefinitions":["When this story is complete, a /dso:fix-bug run that fixes a shell-script bug emits an \"Antipattern-Scan: <query> root=<scan-root> matches=<n>\" commit trailer, produced as the anti-pattern-scan.md SCAN_RESULT trailer_line and copied verbatim into the commit message. \u2190 Satisfies: sc-1","When this story is complete, plugins/dso/hooks/check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh (invoked from a fix-bug commit-step HARD-GATE) refuses the commit when the Antipattern-Scan trailer is absent, or when matches>0 lack a machine-verifiable per-match follow-up artifact (a dso ticket create id in the trailer, the match file appearing in git diff, or a capped \"# antipattern-ok: <reason>\" annotation); the gate covers every fix-bug commit including Phase G fix sub-agents and never gates commits from other skills. \u2190 Satisfies: sc-2","When this story is complete, a shell/bash RED test that does not reproduce under plugins/dso/scripts/run-hermetic.sh triggers a HARD-GATE full stop (fix implementation halts, the ticket records a \"Hermetic reproduction failed\" comment, investigation restarts at Phase C); non-shell runners instead emit a machine-checkable \"HERMETIC_SKIP: runner=<runner> reason=non-shell\" token and are never blocked. \u2190 Satisfies: sc-3","When this story is complete, Phase G includes a promote-query sub-step that appends the surfaced query to known-antipatterns.yaml per epic 7575-5a90's schema when the file exists, or writes a durable \"ANTIPATTERN_PROMOTE_DEFERRED: <query>\" ticket comment when it does not. \u2190 Satisfies: sc-4","When this story is complete, a deterministic regression fixture under tests/ freezes root-cause excerpts of the four Pattern 3 chain files (09d8-11f0, fe45-0b58, 82ad-7bb3, 97a7-4504) and runs the first fix's extracted query against them asserting >=4 matches, running with no original environment required. \u2190 Satisfies: sc-5"],"considerations":["[Performance] Tree-wide antipattern scan runs after every shell-script fix; keep it repo-root-scoped grep/sg so it stays fast on large trees.","[Reliability] Hermetic-repro and trailer checks are HARD-GATEs in the fix-bug commit path; they must fail-closed on genuine antipattern matches yet pass cleanly on the matches=0 path so legitimate commits are never blocked.","[Testing] run-hermetic.sh must clear contaminants (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, exported BASH_FUNC_* functions) while preserving PATH and venv so compound test commands still execute (SC3).","[Maintainability] known-antipatterns.yaml is owned by epic 7575-5a90; coordinate initial file creation / append schema to avoid divergence \u2014 SC4 degrades to ANTIPATTERN_PROMOTE_DEFERRED until the registry lands.","[Security] The \"# antipattern-ok\" annotation escape is capped at 3 per session without an explicit user-approval dialog; the cap must be enforced to prevent silent suppression of real recurrences."],"storyDashboard":{"totalStories":0,"uiStories":0,"criticalPath":[]}}
